content:
To complete this tutorial, your user or role must have an attached identity-based policy with the
following minimum permissions. These permissions allow you to create a pipeline role and attach
a policy (iam:Create* and iam:Attach*), create or modify a collection (aoss:*), and work with
pipelines (osis:*).
In addition, several IAM permissions are required in order to automatically create the pipeline role
and pass it to OpenSearch Ingestion so that it can write data to the collection.

"Version":"2012-10-17",
"Statement":[
{
"Effect":"Allow",
"Resource":"*",
"Action":[
"osis:*",
"iam:Create*",
